question_text: Construct Python function net_profit(profit, months). months is a supplied positive integer number of months charged. A 400000 loan incurs simple interest of 1% of the original principal each month, and land tax is 500 per month. Return profit after deducting interest and tax.
adaptation_rationale: Remove date/spreadsheet APIs beyond required types; retain modular cost calculation with supplied charged-month count. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
